target_definition: CVD == 1 and TIMECVD <= 3652.5 days (Primary Prevention Cohort)
model_selection_rationale: L2-regularized Logistic Regression was selected as the primary 10-year risk model. It achieved the highest 5-fold cross-validation ROC-AUC (0.7823 +/- 0.0282) and test ROC-AUC (0.7648), while avoiding overfitting observed in tree ensembles on this moderately sized cohort (N=3,186 train). It is evaluated strictly on standard_bp (SYSBP, DIABP) to avoid mathematical rank deficiency.
threshold_selection_methodology: Derived strictly from training-set 5-fold cross-validation out-of-fold predictions targeting sensitivity >= 80% with specificity >= 20%. The held-out test set was completely quarantined during threshold selection.
methodological_notice: Formulated as a conditional landmark binary classification model on the primary-prevention cohort (followed >= 10 years or incident CVD event within 10 years; non-CVD deaths < 10y excluded, N=232). This is NOT a competing-risk survival model (such as Fine-Gray subdistribution hazards) and is NOT a clinically validated replacement for established risk calculators (e.g., ACC/AHA Pooled Cohort Equations). Predicted probabilities require external calibration before any clinical interpretation.
